name: darwin-assistant
description: External Darwin AI assistant — voice intake, Slack bot, full Paperclip access

scripts.goals:sim: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/goals-sim.db npx tsx scripts/goals-sim.ts
scripts.goals:review-checks: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/goals-review.db npx tsx scripts/goals-review-checks.ts
scripts.persona-mcp:sim: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/persona-mcp-sim.db npx tsx scripts/persona-mcp-sim.ts
scripts.persona-mcp:review-checks: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/persona-mcp-review.db npx tsx scripts/persona-mcp-review-checks.ts
scripts.tree-cue:check: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/tree-cue-check.db node --import ./scripts/tree-cue-check.hooks.mjs scripts/tree-cue-check.mjs
scripts.goals:guards-check: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/goals-guards.db npx tsx scripts/goals-guards-check.mjs
scripts.goals:autopilot-sim: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/goals-autopilot-sim.db npx tsx scripts/goals-autopilot-sim.ts
scripts.notepad:check: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/notepad-check.db node scripts/notepad-check.mjs
scripts.notepad:sim: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/notepad-sim.db node scripts/notepad-sim.mjs
scripts.throttle:check: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/throttle-check.db JARVIS_SIM=1 node scripts/throttle-check.mjs
scripts.throttle:route-check: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/throttle-route-check.db JARVIS_SIM=1 node scripts/throttle-route-check.mjs
scripts.throttle:sim: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/throttle-sim.db JARVIS_SIM=1 node scripts/throttle-sim.mjs
scripts.health:check: npm run build && JARVIS_DB_PATH=/tmp/health-check.db JARVIS_SIM=1 node --import ./scripts/health-check.hooks.mjs scripts/health-check.mjs
